easy: The amount of medicine you take at one time.

ex.ko: 모두가 나를 쳐다보자 나는 불편했다.

easy: Not feeling cozy or good in your body.

ex.en: The hard bench was uncomfortable.
ex.ko: 딱딱한 벤치는 불편했다.

easy: Of no use; for no good reason.

ex.en: It was a wasted trip because the park was closed.
ex.ko: 공원이 닫혀 있어서 헛걸음이었다.

easy: Not used in a good way.

ex.en: Wasted water ran down the drain.
ex.ko: 낭비된 물이 배수구로 흘러갔다.

easy: Not being strong.

ex.en: After the flu, I felt weakness in my legs.
ex.ko: 독감을 앓은 뒤 다리에 힘이 없었다.

easy: Found or believed in many places by many people.

ex.en: The idea of recycling is widespread in our town.
ex.ko: 재활용에 대한 생각은 우리 동네에 널리 퍼져 있다.

easy: Covering a large area.

ex.en: Widespread rain fell across the whole state.
ex.ko: 넓은 지역에 걸쳐 비가 내렸다.

easy: Okay with something and not upset about it.

ex.en: She was accepting of the new rules.
ex.ko: 그녀는 새 규칙을 순순히 받아들였다.

easy: Able to be reached.

ex.en: Our cabin is accessible by a small boat.
ex.ko: 우리 오두막은 작은 배로 갈 수 있다.

easy: Easy to read and understand.

ex.en: This storybook is accessible to young readers.
ex.ko: 이 이야기책은 어린 독자도 쉽게 읽을 수 있다.

easy: Easy to get or use.

ex.en: Books are accessible in the school library.
ex.ko: 학교 도서관에서는 책을 쉽게 구할 수 있다.

easy: To say that something is true.

ex.en: He acknowledged that he broke the window.
ex.ko: 그는 창문을 깬 것을 인정했다.

easy: To tell someone you got what they sent.

ex.en: Please acknowledge the email so we know you got it.
ex.ko: 메일을 받았다고 답해 주세요.

easy: To show you see someone, like with a wave or a hello.

ex.en: She acknowledged me with a wave.
ex.ko: 그녀는 손을 흔들어 나에게 인사했다.

easy: A public warning about something that might happen, like bad weather.

ex.en: The weather service issued a snow advisory.
ex.ko: 기상청이 대설 주의보를 내렸다.

easy: Being full of energy and life.

ex.en: She told the story with great animation.
ex.ko: 그녀는 아주 활기차게 이야기를 들려주었다.

easy: A job or task you must do.

ex.en: Our assignment was to feed the class fish.
ex.ko: 우리의 임무는 반 물고기에게 밥을 주는 것이었다.

easy: Giving out jobs or places to people.

ex.en: The teacher's assignment of seats was fair.
ex.ko: 선생님의 자리 배정은 공평했다.

easy: Steady, with the same weight on each side.

ex.en: The balanced seesaw did not move.
ex.ko: 균형 잡힌 시소는 움직이지 않았다.
